extracted.intended_audience: corporate reporting teams, CFOs, accountants, auditors and sustainability reporting preparers
extracted.subtask_description: Brief introductory summary of IFRS S1 (general requirements) and IFRS S2 (climate disclosures), noting the June 2023 issuance and a June 2025 update that adds further guidance for ISSB-required disclosure information. Intended to orient preparers and advisers on how the two standards relate and where to find further guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: IFRS S1 — General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information
rubrics_metrics.description: "IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information ... are the first IFRS sustainability disclosure standards. IFRS S1 sets out the general requirements for a complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issued by the ISSB in June 2023; S1 provides the overarching/general requirements that form the basis for a complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures. This EY publication is an updated edition (June 2025) including further guidance for disclosure information required by ISSB standards; consult International GAAP 2026 for the S1 section.

rubrics_metrics.name: IFRS S2 — Climate-related Disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: "IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures ... is a topic-based standard that specifies disclosures relating to climate."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: S2 is a topic-specific standard focused on climate disclosures and was issued by the ISSB in June 2023. Preparers should follow S2's specific disclosure requirements for climate-related matters and use the EY updated guidance (June 2025) where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to apply IFRS S1 in conjunction with IFRS S2
rubrics_metrics.description: "IFRS S1 is designed to be applied in conjunction with IFRS S2, which is a topic-based standard that specifies disclosures relating to climate."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical application: use S1's general requirements together with S2's climate-specific disclosures when preparing sustainability-related financial disclosures. The two standards operate together as the IFRS sustainability disclosure standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated guidance for ISSB-required disclosure information (June 2025 edition)
rubrics_metrics.description: "This edition has been updated to include further guidance for disclosure information required by ISSB standards."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EY's June 2025 update provides additional explanatory guidance for applying ISSB disclosure requirements; readers are directed to consult the updated EY publication and International GAAP 2026 for fuller guidance and examples on implementing S1 and S2.
